title: Auto play piano keyless
features:
Advanced keystroke Emulation: Powered by Roblox's VirtualInputManager, the script simulates actual hardware input. This means it can handle complex black-key modifiers (Sharps/Flats) and rapid-fire chords that are impossible for manual players.
Intelligent Sheet Parsing: The engine doesn't just read text; it understands music. It features a custom bracket-handling logic [...] that allows for simultaneous note execution, creating a rich, harmonic sound.
"Mommy's Favorites" Recommended Library: Forget about hunting for sheets. The script comes integrated with a Recommended tab featuring 7 hand-picked, full-length songs that are tested for rhythm and accuracy.
Universal Sheet Compatibility: Have your own music? The Control Panel includes a dynamic input field where you can paste any standard piano sheet. The script will adapt to your input instantly.
Sleek Rayfield Interface: Enjoy a professional, dark-themed UI that is easy on the eyes. It includes:
Right Control Toggle: Hide the menu instantly to keep your screen clean for recordings or screenshots.
Smooth Notifications: Real-time feedback when a song is loaded or an action is successful.
Zero-Lag Threading: Utilizing task.spawn, the music engine runs on a separate thread, ensuring your game remains smooth while the piano plays.
🛠️ Technical SpecificationsSetup & Instructions
Execution: Run the provided loadstring in a reputable executor.
Selection: Navigate to the "Recommended" tab to browse pre-loaded tracks. Click "Load" on your song of choice.
Customization: If you have a specific song, paste the text into the "Sheet" box in the "Auto Play" tab.
Performance: Sit in front of the in-game piano and click "▶ START / STOP".
Enjoy: Watch as your character performs flawlessly. Press Right Control to hide the UI and enjoy the show!
⚖️ Credits & Disclaimer
Lead Developer: Scyro (Mommy)
UI Library: Rayfield Team
Usage: This script is intended for entertainment purposes. Please use responsibly and respect game-specific rules regarding automation.
"Unleash the virtuoso within—without ever touching a key."
